relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: In contrast, the protein expression of TRPV1 in the spinal cord was significantly elevated in the paclitaxel-treated group compared to the control group (p < 0.05, Figure 8B).

relationships.subject: Commiphora myrrha extract
relationships.object: paclitaxel-induced thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia
relationships.evidence_quote: Prophylactic treatment of mice with CM prevented the development of paclitaxel-induced thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia.

relationships.subject: Commiphora myrrha extract
relationships.evidence_quote: Both the number and duration of the capsaicin-induced nociceptive responses were decreased in CM-treated mice (p < 0.01; Figure 5).

relationships.subject: Commiphora myrrha extract
relationships.evidence_quote: However, paclitaxel + CM-treated animals had a significant increase in the mRNA expression of Nrf2 but not Sod2 and Hmox1 in the paw skin

key_findings: Commiphora myrrha extract reversed established paclitaxel-induced thermal hyperalgesia and, with pretreatment, prevented thermal hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia without motor impairment.
Paclitaxel raised spinal TRPV1 protein; CM reduced capsaicin-evoked nociception and increased paw skin Nrf2 mRNA.
